entities.summary: John Francisco Rechy is a Mexican-American novelist and essayist. His novels are written extensively about gay culture in Los Angeles and wider America, among other subject matter. City of Night, his debut novel published in 1963, was a best seller. Drawing on his own background, he has contributed to Mexican-American literature, notably with his novel The Miraculous Day of Amalia Gomez, which has been taught in several Chicano studies courses throughout the United States. But, even after the success of his first novel, he still worked as a prostitute, teaching during the day, and hustling at night.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a prominent Mexican-American novelist and essayist, John Rechy's work has contributed significantly to Chicano studies courses in the United States, with his novel The Miraculous Day of Amalia Gomez being taught in several institutions. His writing provides valuable insights into gay culture in Los Angeles and wider America.
